newsitem.title: USA: Sirrom Capital offers 2.9 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Sirrom Capital offers 2.9 million shares.

text.p: Sirrom Capital Corp said Wednesday it is pricing its offering of 2,900,000 shares of common stock -- 2,711,286 shares of which were sold by Sirrom -- at a price of $37 each.
Sirrom said it will use the proceeds to provide loans to small businesses. The remaining 188,714 shares were sold by certain shareholders of the Company.
The underwriting was managed by Morgan Stanley & Co, The Robinson-Humphrey Co, J.C. Bradford & Co and Equitable Securities Corp.
Sirrom Capital Corporation is a specialty finance company that makes loans to small businesses as well as acting as a business development company, regulated under the Investment Company Act of 1940.
